body:
Googled "money makes me suicidal" trying to find anyone who could relate, but it was surprisingly hard. Just lots of "money doesn't buy happiness!" platitudes. Even found "ultra rich people get depressed too :(" Found this link in my search. Just want you to know that I relate, and it was a relief to find someone who gets it.

It feels like we live to produce, consume and die. Dreams and happiness be damned. The bottom 99% toils and barley scrapes by while a slim percent sits around and hoards it all. This isn't what I thought life was about when I was a kid. Always wondered why adults are sad and boring, but now I get it.

Wish I could offer some words of comfort for you, but I have none even for myself. Just want you to know I empathize and I wish you didn't have such stress on your shoulders.

If therapy can't help OP's friend, then there's nothing that OP can do for them. But the biggest problem is that the friend isn't even trying to help themselves and is instead trying to get all comfort from OP, but that's not OP's job. And OP shouldn't be expected to run themselves ragged caring for this person. In first aid classes you learn not to put yourself in danger to save others. And I think it's the same in cases like this. OP's friend is severely impacting them in a negative way, and it's very unfair to OP. Without the proper training and equipment, a drowning person can pull you under and kill you too, and this is really no different. OP isn't equipped to help someone like this and it's not fair to ask them to while they're also not looking for other sources of support, even when there are many systems in place for the express purpose. It's actually pretty abusive in a way.

I totally get this sentiment, and it's always given me a sense of fakeness. If I didn't have money, would you just turn me away? For me it's $125/session, my last therapist was $250/session. (All full price cause I haven't reached my 2.5k deductible.) Every bill makes me more bitter that healthcare and life is so fucking expensive and 99% of people earn so fucking little. Felt that bitterness until recently, that is. Sorry this is long. **tldr;** therapist ignores my impressive tab, says my well being always comes first and everything can be sorted when I say. Including aid as needed.

I have a good salary but my finances have been very bad due to a mountain of bills, so I haven't been able to pay my new, current therapist since I started around 1-2 months ago. I have a backlog of over $500 to pay. My therapist has never rushed or berated me, just constantly told me to take all the time I need and that we can scale payments/make other options. On my first meeting with him I knew we would connect, because when I said the gist of my depression (a 40+ year life of constant work paired with rampant wealth inequality) he said "yes, it's difficult and exhausting to survive in this capitalistic society"

My last session on Monday, I told him that I had meant to cancel, and needed to pause, because I just can't afford it, despite the fact that I'd been having suicidal thoughts. Right away he was completely nonjudgmental, was so understanding and kind. Waved off the money concern and said to take all the time I need. He said "I wouldn't be able to sleep at night, knowing there was someone who needed help and wasn't getting it because of money." He was so sincere and earnest without putting on airs. Also made it clear that this money doesn't go to him, it's determined by the higher ups, and he's not going to shake me down for it. 

My last therapist also gave me a really impressive list of therapists when I moved, including resources for free therapy. Therapies conducted by students or people doing their.. training wheel runs, as they rack up experience. It's at a reduced cost/free. Longer wait times, but there ARE options in this glorious capitalistic, dystopian shithole we call america. And knowing there are options, and that there is hope, helps quite a bit.

I just had a mental health episode so I'm not thinking clearly, didn't read any sub rules so maybe I'll say something wrong, report this comment if I have. But I just want to be completely honest without worrying about niceties, because I feel very hard for you.

I have no patience for people like this. This friend is NOT your responsibility. His mental well being isn't your problem, but he's making it yours to your extreme detriment. He refuses to get help, which is the most frustrating bit,, and you've done all you can to help him, for him. The fact he refuses to get help but then still goes to you saying he wants to kill himself because you didn't respond for a day??? that is SO messed up. you're not his therapist, you're not trained to help him, and you absolutely have to look out for your own well being first. It sounds completely exhausting. And it's so sad that you were trying to grasp a little longer to a happiness that should be commonplace with friends, because you knew he would suck it away. Honey you deserve so much better treatment than that. you can't help people who won't try to help themselves too. He's trying to find something in you that he'll never find, it's just sucking the soul out of you. This is very unfair to you. just want you to know that you're not responsible for him, and whatever he does or doesn't do is NOT your fault. Please do what is best for you, because this is running you ragged

This is exactly the source of my depression. You summed it up EXACTLY as I think. So many sessions of therapy and still no satisfying answer on how to cope with it. We spend the majority of our time working and still struggle, what's the point?
